Jenny Dürst (born 25 March 1999) is a Swiss tennis player. Dürst has a career-high singles ranking by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) of 320, achieved on 16 June 2025. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 187, achieved on 17 July 2023. [ 1 ] Dürst won her first $60k title at the 2022 TCCB Open in the doubles draw, partnering with Weronika Falkowska .
